plugins.name: tolvi
plugins.description: Read, write, and ask questions of a Tolvi engineering vault: decisions, sessions and patterns as plain Markdown your agents read as context.

plugins.name: tolvi-guild
plugins.description: Substrate-grounded brainstorming and planning: works out the how against the guardrails already in your codebase, and asks where the code is silent.

plugins.name: tolvi-bastion
plugins.description: A pre-code crucible: interrogates a plan against your vault before any code exists, hardens it, and deposits the rationale as decisions.

plugins.name: tolvi-magellan
plugins.description: Executor-agnostic plan compiler: turns an approved brief into a context-compiled task DAG that carries exactly the decisions and refs each task needs.

plugins.name: tolvi-solo
plugins.description: A vault for solo builders: capture decisions, patterns and session notes as plain Markdown, with no server setup.
